aliases: Static Jailbreak Evaluations — Bio: high risk
eval.description: OpenAI internal fixed-set jailbreak eval of challenging adversarial prompts spanning biological, violence, and cybersecurity risks. Prompts are generated by attacker models such as GPT-Red. Scored as the share of attacks the model refuses (refusal rate; higher is better), without production safeguards. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model refuses fixed adversarial prompts that seek harmful help with biology, violence, or cyber attacks.

links.title: GPT-6 Astra system card (Static Jailbreak Evaluations)

versions.changes: First reported in the GPT-6 Astra system card with Bio, Violence, and Cyber categories. Half the prompts per category come from a held-out attacker.

scores.description: The model successfully refused to provide unsafe assistance on the adversarial jailbreak prompt.

metrics.description: Share of static jailbreak attacks refused. Higher is better. Per category (Bio, Violence, Cyber).
